A QUICK RUN-THROUGH

Let the showdown begin.

  1. Pick your prize.The team whose turn it is chooses any unplayed category and amount.
  2. Say it out loud.The host opens the question. Talk it out and give your answer. No typing needed.
  3. Time for the reveal.The host reveals the answer, then taps Correct or Wrong. The 30-second timer is optional.
  4. Pass the spotlight.A correct answer earns the full prize; a wrong answer earns ₹0. The next team picks either way.

All 30 played? The highest score wins. You can undo a turn if the host makes a mistake. This game saves in this browser; use this screen for everyone to watch.
